title: Certificate-mapped identities can authenticate by password on another listener
summary:
### Background

NATS is an open source messaging system for cloud, on-premises and edge deployments.

NATS Server can map TLS client certificates to configured users. Multiple listeners can share user definitions while using different authentication settings.

### Problem Description

A certificate-only identity with an empty password could be accepted using username and empty-password authentication on another listener where certificate mapping was not enabled. Knowledge of the configured identity could therefore be sufficient to connect without the intended client certificate. Leafnode, WebSocket and MQTT listeners could provide the alternate path.

### Affected Versions

The issue is fixed in v2.12.14, v2.14.4 and v2.15.0. Earlier versions containing the affected functionality are vulnerable; the first affected version has not been established for this notice.

### Workarounds

Upgrade to a fixed release.

### References

 * GHSA advisory: <https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server/security/advisories/GHSA-q57r-qh7g-9wgm>
